entries.intent: Empty state a new writer meets right after creating a project.

entries.intent: Everyday reading and writing in a branching hub: speakers, replies, destinations, effects.

entries.title: Script, focus mode
entries.intent: Long-session writing with chrome reduced.

entries.intent: The continuous scene: a later beat brought to the top under the running head, read-only beats around it, and a focused beat heading.

entries.title: Script, a long scene's beat list
entries.intent: A scene of forty beats lists them in a scrolling list under its row, a half row showing there are more, kept on the selected later beat; then a beat row focused.

entries.title: Script, margin marks
entries.intent: Unsaved work and a problem beside the beat, repeated in the scene list: the halftone dot, the error wedge, the crop marks.

entries.intent: The next run's inputs on an anchored slip over the running preview, which stays in place beneath it.

entries.intent: A change made outside Writer, as a banner at the top of the sheet with Compare, Keep mine and Use disk version.

entries.intent: Build as a command: the writing view stays, and the result waits on a slip above the status line; a failure offers its report.

entries.title: Inline rename
entries.intent: F2 turns the selected beat's heading, or a double-click its sidebar row, into a field, and Rename beat in Commands asks which beat first; Enter reviews the rename, and a slip under the field says what it changes before Rename stages it.

entries.title: Inline rename on a card
entries.intent: F2 or a double-click turns a card's title into a field; the consequence slip hangs under the card, inside the map.

entries.title: Insertion, speaker and destination slips
entries.intent: After the beat, + Line and + Reply insert after the passage being written; its speaker label or destination is the control whose choice opens as a slip hanging from it, on the current value.
